function: no_learning: beamforming, RIS phases, computing frequency, bandwidth and user selection are optimized by successive linear programming, a classical iterative algorithm (p. 1, p. 7); FL is only the served application, aggregated digitally (p. 10).
notes: Title and DOI match on p. 1. The EE maximization (MINLP) is relaxed and 'solved with an iterative algorithm based on successive linear programming (SLP)' (p. 1), with Taylor linearization, penalty and trust region (p. 7, Algorithm 2 on p. 9). Learning is only the application: the FL uplink is digital, FDMA with rates 'Rk = bk log2(1 + Gamma_k)' (p. 4) or NOMA where 'the central server aggregates the updated model parameters and decodes the received signals using the SIC' (p. 10), so there is no over-the-air computation and the FL exception of no_learning does not apply. The simulations report only energy efficiency and train no model (pp. 10-13). Even if it passed no_learning, it would fail function (digital FL is outside area 7).
